dedupe_keys.name: metropole de lyon district heating datasets

description: Métropole de Lyon: district heating datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about district heating; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Périmètres contractuels des réseaux de chaleur et de froid de la Métro; Sous-stations des réseaux de chaleur et de froid de la Métropole de Ly; Périmètre de classement (obligation de raccordement) des réseaux de ch; Chaufferies et centrales de production de froid des réseaux de chaleur. Formats seen: CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
